title: Super-Green Soup
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, florets cut away, stalk trimmed and chopped
400g (14oz) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
method: Spray oil into a large deep casserole dish and fry the onions and celery over a medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the fennel, garlic, courgettes and broccoli stalks and fry gently for 10 minutes.
Pour in the hot stock and add the chickpeas, bring to the boil and cook at a fast simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets, parsley and spinach, pop a lid on the pan and simmer for 7-8 minutes until the broccoli is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, squeeze in the lemon juice and use a hand blender to blend into a smooth soup, or leave chunkier if preferred.
notes: Don't throw away broccoli stalks — trim away the tough outer bits and slice into coins to add to the soup.
